symptom: `alter agent`, `alter knowledge base` and `create or modify agent|ai model|knowledge base` report success and every check stays green, but the Agent Editor document loses what mxcli does not model: per tool userAccessApproval, displayTitle, displayDescription; on the agent enableBackendStreaming, enableUIStreaming, selectedModel; on a knowledge base tool minSimilarity; the knowledge base's Contents name becomes ''; on create or modify the model's type and name become ''. create or modify agent also writes a microflow tool with no document (it runs nothing), an MCP service tool with no document, every tool with an empty id, and the entity reference with an empty documentId.
file: mdl/backend/modelsdk/agenteditor_carry.go (carryStoredContents, contentsSpec) wired in agenteditor_write.go writeCustomBlob; mdl/executor/cmd_agenteditor_carry.go (carryAgentIdentity, carryEntityRef); buildAgentToolFromDef in cmd_agenteditor_alter.go now shared by create; visitor toolBlockDef reads Document/ToolType. Tests: agenteditor_carry_test.go (fixtures testdata/agenteditor/*.11_16.json), cmd_agenteditor_carry_test.go
cause: The four Contents encoders marshal a typed struct, so a rewrite keeps only the modelled keys; the knowledge base encoder hard-coded name "". On the create path the visitor ignored a tool block's Document and ToolType that describe prints, the executor compared ToolType to "mcp" while the visitor sets "MCP", tools were built without ids, and the executor rebuilt Model/KB without the Portal-picked fields the statement cannot spell.
insight: **Measure the whole document set, byte for byte, not the reported key.** The reproduction that mattered was describe → exec of every agent-editor document of a real 11.16 app (33 in FactoryManagement, plus ICXGraphPilot's Agent Editor-created agent) and a JSON diff of Contents before/after: it surfaced the unmodelled keys, the dropped microflow target, the blanked ids, the zero-valued keys mxcli adds, and that Agent Editor 2.6 stores Contents indented by two spaces while older documents and agent-importer ones are compact — a compact rewrite of an unchanged indented document was a write every time. The carry pairs tool entries by id, so the executor must carry stored tool ids (by type + name, MCP by service) or the backend carry has nothing to pair with. A modelled optional key the statement cleared stays out (otherwise it could never be removed); an empty/zero value the stored document never held is not added. Watch the harness: `grep -v WARNING` to strip mxcli's banner also deleted a prompt line containing "WARNING" and looked like a describe bug. Controls: returning the rebuilt JSON fails both backend carry tests; a no-op carryAgentIdentity, dropping the model/KB carries, or disabling the microflow resolution fails each executor test with the reported symptom.
